task_spec.text: Identify the workspace where an admin asked when the MCP deployment would be done, in #general.
Create a new channel named budget-followup within that workspace.

access_plan: Use conversations.history on #general (C01ABCD1234) to locate the MCP-deployment message and its author (messages.user_id → users.user_id); confirm the author's admin role via user_teams (matching user_teams.user_id to the same author) scoped to that workspace; this resolves the single workspace's team_id via channels.team_id, then call conversations.create with that team_id and name 'budget-followup'.
